fixture: Generated original 720-second harmonic performance, looped five times; not commercial audio
scope: Actual Basic Pitch adapter and performance MIDI; no browser, API, worker restart, or notation rendering in this capacity check

manifest.time_basis: seconds relative to selected clip; unquantized

windowing.implementation: streamed upstream model.predict windows; disk-backed global activations
windowing.reconciliation: trim model overlap; assemble complete sample-aligned global activation timeline; extract notes once globally, retaining repeated onsets and sustained notes

cleanup.merge_rule: same pitch/part, bounded gap or overlap, continuous frame activation >=0.3, boundary onset <0.2, local frame rise <0.15

manifest.model_score_semantics: mean model note activation for a raw event; merged notes use the maximum source activation; not calibrated accuracy
manifest.pitch_bend_semantics: original pitch bends are retained in raw-note-events.json and upstream raw-performance.mid where MIDI permits; editable normalized notes currently contain discrete pitches only
manifest.velocity_semantics: MIDI velocity derived by rounding model amplitude * 127; editable and not measured playing force
manifest.original_timing_semantics: earliest source event snapshot; merged source events remain in raw-note-events.json via source_note_ids

resources_scope: Entire audit Python process, including model/MIDI parsing; excludes FFmpeg child

synthetic_reference_comparison.scope: Post-analysis comparison only; reference events were never passed to inference. Repeated synthetic fixture does not establish performance on commercial songs.
